english.note: Use 單位 for a standard measurement or for one apartment in a housing development; it is the all-purpose choice in these contexts.
Use this for a unit such as a gram, metre, or other measurement unit.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan1 wai2 jau5 saam1 gaan1 fong2

examples.english: A metre is a unit of measure for length.
examples.jyutping: mai5 hai6 coeng4 dou6 ge3 daan1 wai2

english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese choice for a self-contained flat, especially when discussing renting or buying one.

examples.english: This apartment has two bedrooms, just right for our family.
examples.traditional: 呢個單位有兩間房，啱晒我哋一家人住。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan1 wai2 jau5 loeng5 gaan1 fong2 ngaam1 saai3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zyu6
